title: Hosting Local AI with Ollama, OpenwebUI on Docker
subtitle: hosting your local ai for privacy and control
summary: a guide to set up your local AI

content.text: Hosting your very own AI is easy the hard part is own and finding hardware to run in on in the age of AI everything expensive and sometime even you have the finance to buy doesn't you can buy. Hardware become rare and people go back and reused old hardware to run things.
Everything is run on Docker for easy managament and operation, Through Docker compose you can run multiple docker container from a single docker-compose file.
Download Docker Desktop from offical source.

content.code:
# Update system packages, install Docker and Docker Compose, then enable and start the Docker service,
# and add the current user to the 'docker' group to run Docker commands without sudo.
sudo pacman -Syu docker docker-compose && sudo systemctl enable --now docker.service && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
